ping-server.desc: To check the API server status

simple-price.summary: Coin Price by IDs, Symbols, or Names
simple-price.desc: To query the prices of one or more coins by using their unique Coin API IDs, symbols, or names

search-data.desc: To search for coins, categories and markets listed on CoinGecko

simple-supported-currencies.desc: To query all the supported currencies on CoinGecko

simple-token-price.desc: To query one or more token prices by using their token contract addresses

coins-list.desc: To query all the supported coins on CoinGecko with coin ID, name and symbol

coins-id.desc: To query all the metadata (image, websites, socials, description, contract address, etc.) and market data (price, ATH, exchange tickers, etc.) of a coin based on a particular coin ID

coins-markets.desc: To query all the supported coins with price, market cap, volume and market related data

coins-id-tickers.desc: To query the coin tickers on both centralized exchange (CEX) and decentralized exchange (DEX) based on a particular coin ID

coins-id-history.desc: To query the historical data (price, market cap, 24hrs volume, etc.) at a given date for a coin based on a particular coin ID

coins-id-market-chart.summary: Coin Historical Chart Data by ID

coins-id-market-chart-range.summary: Coin Historical Chart Data within Time Range by ID
coins-id-market-chart-range.desc: To get the historical chart data of a coin within certain time range in UNIX along with price, market cap and 24hrs volume based on particular coin ID

coins-id-ohlc.desc: To get the OHLC chart (Open, High, Low, Close) of a coin based on particular coin ID

coins-contract-address.desc: To query all the metadata (image, websites, socials, description, contract address, etc.) and market data (price, ATH, exchange tickers, etc.) of a coin based on an asset platform and a particular token contract address

contract-address-market-chart.summary: Coin Historical Chart Data by Token Address

contract-address-market-chart-range.summary: Coin Historical Chart Data within Time Range by Token Address

asset-platforms-list.desc: To query all the supported asset platforms (blockchain networks) on CoinGecko

token-lists.summary: Token Lists by Asset Platform ID

coins-categories-list.desc: To query all the supported coins categories on CoinGecko

coins-categories.summary: Coins Categories List with Market Data
